name: ecommerce-recommendations
description: The claim that one product is worth showing next to another and the evidence behind it: derived signals, generation runs, scored affinities per strategy, and the placement a surface was served with its exclusions and its explanation.
features: Analytics owns the observation and this module owns the inference; it stores derived signals of its own and reads no event stream belonging to another module
A signal arrives either by a direct call or through the SignalSource seam, and with nothing bound the module ingests nothing rather than inventing page-view tracking
The module never calls session(): a signal carries whatever subject reference the caller supplies, and a signal with no subject is a legitimate popularity input
An affinity is a derived directional scored claim between two catalogue references owned by one strategy, and a placement is what a surface asked for and what it was given
Four strategies and no more: collaborative, content_similarity, popularity and manual, as a backed enum, so adding one is a code change with a test rather than a row
The strategy is part of the affinity's unique key, so two strategies may both claim one pair and neither silently overwrites the other's score
A score is a ratio in zero to one that its strategy can defend, never a count divided by an assumed maximum, and the model refuses anything outside that range
Scores are normalised per strategy against the candidate set actually read, at serve time, so a popularity score and a co-purchase confidence can be ranked against each other
Generation is a run that records its strategy, window, counts in and out and outcome; an affinity the newest successful run did not reassert is superseded, with an audit row
A derived claim about people is withheld unless a configurable floor of distinct subjects stands behind it, so an aggregate that could single somebody out is never asserted
Content similarity is a statement about the catalogue rather than about people, so the anonymity floor does not apply to it
Co-occurrence is counted by distinct occurrence, so one order carrying a product on two lines is one piece of evidence and not four
A manual affinity outranks a computed one of any score, and the placement names which produced each entry
Every serve path is deterministic: same store, same shopper, same catalogue state, same window gives the same list, and variety takes an explicit seed the placement stores
There is no implicit fallback from an anchored slot to popularity, because a fallback is what made an empty answer indistinguishable from a broken one
Every empty placement names the precondition that failed: no signal source bound, no signals recorded, no generation run, no affinities for the anchor, or all candidates excluded
Exclusions are one list evaluated once — is-anchor, already-purchased, already-in-cart, out-of-stock, suppressed, unresolvable reference — and every removal is counted on the placement
An unresolvable catalogue reference is reported as an exclusion rather than dropped, so asking for ten and getting four always has an answer
A placement is recorded before it is returned, so the explanation the shopper sees and the one an operator audits are the same row
Candidates are ordered and limited in SQL rather than after hydration, and the catalogue is referenced by opaque string and never joined
Erasure removes a person's signals and placements across every tenant and keeps the aggregate affinities their behaviour contributed to; export walks the same set
A subject-keyed signal carries a retention window, and a host that never configured one gets a refusal rather than a window of zero
Every table carries tenant_id NOT NULL with no default, and every relation restates it under a guard that survives withCount
